input.question: When was the Delta Upsilon Fraternity House built?

documents.text: Delta Upsilon Fraternity House (Ann Arbor, Michigan) The Delta Upsilon Fraternity House is a fraternity house located at 1331 Hill Street in Ann Arbor, Michigan. It was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1995. Delta Upsilon was founded in 1834 at Williams College in Williamstown, Massachusetts. The chapter at the University of Michigan was founded in 1874. By the early 1920s, the chapter needed a new house. Alumni pooled donations, and the chapter hired Detroit architect Albert Kahn to design this new house. Construction began in 1920, and was completed in 1921. Delta Upsilon was the first to have a dedicated fraternity house on campus.
